name: Amanogawa Ruri
source:
Vice president of the Regional Culture Research Club. A sophomore in college. She is Inori’s close friend and shares special memories with her.

She has a serious and honest personality and is the type who gets along well with everyone. She loves sweets. As a result, she doesn’t strongly assert her own opinions and tends to go along with others easily.

She joined the club because Inori invited her.
